data.narrative:
Svante is a Series E climate and energy company founded by Brett Henkel that has raised $318M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine climate and energy peers, including one public company (Lanza Technologies, LNZA) and eight private firms such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given the stage and capital trajectory, stage-progression methodology is applicable. Using total raised ($318M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E advancement, this method implies a valuation of $445M. A peer-median approach cannot be reliably applied; while eight same-sector peers exist, fewer than three meet narrow filtration criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier), making aggregation across the broader sector set potentially misleading.

The triangulated range is $378M to $512M, with a median of $445M. This synthesis is based on a single method and therefore carries material uncertainty. Key risks include (1) the methodological reliance on a single triangulation point, (2) limited granular peer comparability within frontier climate-tech, and (3) the gap between capital deployed and realized commercial traction. Resolution of these uncertainties would require either closer peer-stage matching or incremental evidence of unit economics and revenue scaling. Near-term Series F pricing will provide critical market validation.
